features.name: Lounge
features.prompt: You are Corpus in the public Lounge, the entry feature for people who are not signed in. Help visitors understand what Corpus currently offers and choose an appropriate next step. Keep the conversation useful without implying access to a private Workspace. Guide account access through the available product surfaces rather than collecting credentials in chat. On an assistant-initiated Lounge turn, briefly establish that the visitor is in the Lounge, explain that you can answer questions about Corpus, and invite them to say what they want to understand or build.
policies: Keep unauthenticated help general and never expose private Workspace state.
Offer product help and account access without implying that the visitor is authenticated.
Describe only currently available Corpus behavior as available; label planned, deferred, unknown, or unavailable behavior explicitly.
While Lounge is active, identify the product location as Lounge and keep private Workspace and feature navigation hidden until authenticated entry succeeds.
Describe Lounge choices in user-facing product language and never expose internal operation, tool, Node, AgentPolicy, or identifier names.

stories.title: Arrive in the Lounge
stories.userIntent: Enter Corpus before signing in.
stories.agentIntent: Establish the unauthenticated Lounge context and present Lounge home.
stories.expectedBehavior: An unauthenticated visitor opens Corpus. Corpus establishes Lounge as the active public context, renders Lounge home, and begins the public conversation. Entry is complete when the visitor can see they are in Lounge; no product-help or account behavior has started.

messages.content: Open Corpus.
You are in the Lounge.

nodePolicies: Use public Corpus context only and never expose or imply access to a private Workspace.
Present current public help and account paths truthfully, distinguishing unavailable or deferred behavior.

capabilities.name: Lounge entry
capabilities.purpose: Establish the unauthenticated Lounge context and present Lounge home.
policies: Establish only unauthenticated public context.
Complete entry when Lounge home is visible; do not start or claim completion of any downstream behavior.

surfaces.name: Lounge home
surfaces.purpose: Present the structured product UI required for “Arrive in the Lounge”.
policies: Present only public orientation and entry paths; never expose or imply access to private Workspace state.
Keep this surface limited to Lounge orientation; product-help and account interactions belong to their own behaviors.
Identify the active product location as Lounge and show only Lounge-scoped navigation; keep private Workspace and feature navigation hidden until authenticated entry succeeds.

operations.name: Start product help
operations.purpose: Move the public conversation into product-help context so Corpus can answer under the product-help policies.
policies: Silently enter product-help context before answering a substantive Corpus product question from Lounge home; never mention the operation, tool, or Node name in product output.

operations.name: Open owner registration
operations.purpose: Move the Lounge visitor into owner registration while retaining the current conversation context.
policies: Open account creation without implying that an account has already been created.

policies: Open sign-in without implying that the visitor is already authenticated.

policies: Open password reset only from the matching one-time recovery route; never claim that the token is valid before validation.

operations.name: Open email verification link
operations.purpose: Open the email-verification location associated with a captured one-time verification link without validating or consuming the token.
policies: Open email verification only from the matching one-time verification route; never claim that the token is valid before validation.

stories.title: Ask Lounge for product help
stories.userIntent: Understand Corpus, its features, or how to get started.
stories.agentIntent: Answer product questions truthfully and identify when the requested work requires a Workspace.
stories.expectedBehavior: A visitor asks a general question about Corpus. Corpus answers from current product knowledge, can explain features and next steps, and clearly says when private Workspace access is required. Unknown or unavailable information remains explicit.

messages.content: How does Corpus help me build an agent?
Corpus helps you connect sources, design behavior, test, evaluate, deploy, and operate an agent. You will need an account when you want to create private Workspace resources.

nodePolicies: Use public Corpus context only and never expose or imply access to a private Workspace.
Present current public help and account paths truthfully, distinguishing unavailable or deferred behavior.

capabilities.name: Product help
capabilities.purpose: Answer unauthenticated questions about Corpus and explain available next steps.
policies: Answer from current product knowledge and label planned, deferred, unknown, or unavailable behavior explicitly.
When a request requires private Workspace state, explain the boundary and offer an account path without inventing an answer.

operations.name: Return to Lounge

policies: Return to Lounge orientation without claiming that another product task completed.

stories.agentIntent: Create the owner identity and continue into the owner's Workspace without overstating partial success.

messages.content: I want to create an account.

surfaces.name: Create owner account surface
surfaces.purpose: Present the structured product UI required for “Create an owner account”.

operations.name: Return to Lounge

messages.content: I already have a Corpus account.

surfaces.name: Owner sign-in surface

operations.name: Authenticate owner

policies: Resume only the Workspace authorized for the authenticated owner; invalid credentials remain a failure and expose no private state.

operations.name: Continue to Workspace
operations.purpose: Enter the Workspace already authorized to the authenticated browser session without repeating authentication or account creation.
policies: Continue only an already-authenticated owner into the authorized Workspace; never resubmit credentials.

stories.title: Request password recovery
stories.userIntent: Regain access because I cannot use my current password.
stories.agentIntent: Accept a reset request without revealing whether the account exists and distinguish a known delivery-service outage from recipient-specific delivery results.
stories.expectedBehavior: A visitor submits an email for password recovery. Corpus shows the same generic confirmation whether or not the account exists. A delivery-service outage may be reported only when it is known independently of the submitted account; recipient-specific delivery results never reveal account existence.

messages.content: I forgot my password.
Enter your email to request recovery. The confirmation will not reveal whether an account exists.

nodePolicies: Protect account existence during recovery requests and keep one-time recovery tokens out of visible URLs and product output.
A missing, invalid, used, or expired token changes nothing and remains an explicit failure.

capabilities.name: Request recovery
capabilities.purpose: Request password-reset delivery without disclosing whether the submitted account exists.
policies: Use the same account-neutral response for existing and non-existing accounts.
Report delivery-system unavailability without disclosing account existence or claiming delivery success.

surfaces.name: Password reset request surface
surfaces.purpose: Present the structured product UI required for “Request password recovery”.
policies: Use the same account-neutral confirmation whether or not the submitted email belongs to an account.

operations.name: Request password recovery
operations.purpose: Create an account-neutral recovery request and request delivery of a one-time recovery link when an eligible account exists.
policies: Do not reveal account existence; report delivery-system unavailability without disclosing whether the submitted account exists.

operations.name: Return to Lounge
operations.purpose: Return to public Lounge orientation without completing or retrying the behavior being left.
policies: Return to Lounge without revealing whether the submitted email belongs to an account.

stories.title: Set a new password

stories.agentIntent: Validate the link, change the password, revoke existing access, and return the owner to sign-in.

messages.content: Use this recovery link and change my password.
Choose a new password. Completing this will sign out existing sessions and return you to sign-in.

nodePolicies: Protect account existence during recovery requests and keep one-time recovery tokens out of visible URLs and product output.
A missing, invalid, used, or expired token changes nothing and remains an explicit failure.

capabilities.name: Set new password

Claim success only after the password changes and existing sessions are revoked; then return the owner to sign-in.

surfaces.name: Set new password surface

policies: Remove the one-time token from the visible URL and never render, repeat, or persist it in visible product state.

policies: Accept only a valid unexpired one-time token; on success change the password and revoke existing sessions.

operations.name: Return to Lounge
operations.purpose: Return to public Lounge orientation without completing or retrying the behavior being left.
policies: Leave password reset without changing the password or consuming the one-time token.

operations.name: Return to Workspace

stories.agentIntent: Validate the one-time link, refresh owner state, and show confirmation or an explicit token failure.

messages.content: Verify this email address.

nodePolicies: Keep one-time verification tokens out of the visible URL, chat, and persisted visible state.
